definitions.explanation: going somewhere with the intention of staying overnight, rather than returning the same day

examples.japanese: {泊|と}まりがけで{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going to the hot springs for an overnight stay.

examples.japanese: {泊|と}まりがけの{出張|しゅっちょう}が{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I have an overnight business trip.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}の{家|いえ}に{泊|と}まりがけで{遊|あそ}びに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to stay overnight at my friend's house.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{泊|と}まり (staying) + がけ (in the process of/about to)

USAGE:
- {泊|と}まりがけで - with an overnight stay (adverbial use)
- {泊|と}まりがけの～ - ～ involving an overnight stay
- {出張|しゅっちょう} (business trip)
- {旅行|りょこう} (travel)
- {温泉|おんせん} (hot springs)
- {友人|ゆうじん}の{家|いえ} (friend's house)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {泊|と}まりがけ - overnight stay (planned)
- {日帰|ひがえ}り - day trip (returning same day)
- {外泊|がいはく} - staying out overnight (often unplanned)
